evidence: In the ALD deposition process, the precursors for Ga, O, and N were tris(dimethylamino)silane (TMG), O2 and NH3 plasma, respectively. Since TMG has a high vapor pressure at room temperature, the precursor was cooled down to 10 oC, and stabilized prior to deposition. O 2 and NH3 plasma were activated at 200W. Deposition of all films was performed at 200 oC and ~3.5 mbar. Figure 1a provides a schematic diagram of ALD cycles in the GaOxNy growth process. Four steps are contained in each ALD cycle: (1) TMG pulse, (2) Ar purge, (3) plasma processing, and (4) Ar purge. The O 2 and NH3 were led into the ALD chamber with several ratios ranging from 0:100 sccm (i.e. O2 ratio is 0%) to 100:0 sccm (i.e. O2 ratio is 100%) to obtain a co-deposition and direct growth of GaOxNy film in a single ALD cycle, the detailed deposition parameters are displayed in Table S1 in supporting information.
